rows.en: Pulling dirty tricks like that!! I'll blast 'em myself!!
The match venue has been changed? And it's inside the Ultra Tower?
...That's suspicious. Be very careful.
So it was a trap after all...!!
Yeah... Who knows what tricks they'll pull from here on...
What are you afraid of! We're running out of time, aren't we!?
Listen. For the sake of justice, there are times you have to go even when you know it's a trap.
And now is that time!!
...You're right. Thanks, Rider 2.
Are you a Gundam too?
Yeah. I'm Neo Japan's Gundam Fighter.
Gundam Fighter?
Yeah. In the world I came from, once every four years there's this thing called the "Gundam Fight"...
a tournament where every nation's Gundams fight each other. And I'm my country's representative.
Every nation has its own Gundam...!!
Yeah. Instead of going to war, they compete in the tournament.
A world where war has been eradicated...!!
So this is the base...
The time limit's almost up! Hurry to the Plasma Spark Tower!
The final tournament... There's no more room for hesitation.
Fight your way to the top and rescue Taro.
Gaoh, the leader of a gang of robbers...
Yes. Apparently they collect nothing but high-end items and send them on to the next Cube.
High-end items, such as?
Word is he recently got his hands on the "Xtreme Memory."
Yeah, I know. I want it back, no matter what it takes.
If only we knew where that Cube they're sending the items to is...
Sure would be nice if my "K-Taros" was there too, huh.
K-Taros?
It's the gadget I use to turn into "Climax Form."
Climax Form?
Quit askin' about every little thing! You can kinda figure it out, can't ya?
Well, it is called "Climax," after all.
Yeah, yeah! It's the one that comes in and nails it when it counts!!
Okay... I think I sort of get it.
What about Taro!? He should be on the top floor of the Plasma Spark Tower.
Hurry and go rescue him.
This Cube should be where the "power" we lost lies dormant.
If we can take it back, the tide of battle should swing sharply in our favor.
A Museum? So it exhibits items from every world?
Yeah. The Taboo Dopant flat-out...
went as far as saying, "There's nothing the Museum doesn't have."
Now that's quite a boast.
Still, there's no doubt this Cube is important to the enemy.
If we capture it, they should take a serious blow.
...A code, then? "I desire the memory of GAIA"...
The "GAIA" part bothers me.
It might be an acronym for something. Do you have any idea what?
A medal exhibit room... Just as the Taboo Dopant said.
There should be other exhibits too. Keep exploring.
It looks like you got OOO's Core Medals back.
Yes!
And we took out Kazari, too. That makes things a whole lot easier.
Now all that's left is getting back to our own world...
But to do that...
we gotta take down whoever's running this world.
That's right. Otherwise, true peace will never come to Earth.
Then all that's left is... the "Xtreme Memory," right?
It must be somewhere. Keep up the search.
What!? Arche Gundam has appeared!?
Arche Gundam... He's a warmonger. An extremely tough opponent...
Yeah... I ran into him in the "Desert Cube" too.
And he had new-model mobile dolls under his command.
It seems the enemy is steadily building up its forces.
But... what are they planning to do, hauling off GN Drive Taus in bulk?
And where did they take them?
...Another Cube, maybe?
...Probably. I doubt the "Shocker Cube" has any Gundam-type facilities.
But we still have an objective in this Cube. Search for the lost "power" and recover it.
Understood. Moving to search operations.
Mission accepted...!!
So you defeated Bogarl!
By the way, what was that glowing object?
...What? You didn't check!?
It could be something important, you know!?
...I see. So Bogarl had swallowed Dada, key ring and all.
Thanks to that, you can now open almost every door in the Cube...
Search every corner and take back our "power"!
The "Gaia Impact"... What a terrifying plan.
You must stop it, no matter what.

notes.note: Zero, reacting to Seven's #0.283 (Alien Alliance brought out Black King mid-match).
Sentence continues from #0.312; English cut at the same point. 'My country's representative' = Neo Japan's.
Saki no kyuubu read as 'the next Cube' (a Cube further along), where Gaoh ships the loot.
Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros) per script, though the line echoes Violence Dopant's story line; kept Momotaros-casual.

K-Taros = official English spelling of the Den-O item; not in glossary.
Zoffy. 'Power' in quotes as source (the heroes' lost powers).
Ankh's sentence spans #0.377-0.378; cut at the same point.
Kouryaku sareru (passive, enemy's view): 'if we capture it, they take a heavy blow'. Subject restored as the heroes/enemy.
Kashiragoji = initials/acronym. Addressed to the party (Zoffy asking if they have any idea).
Zoffy's sentence is finished by Ankh in #0.412; English cut to match.
Talk01_46 skips this row (plays offsets 0-5, 7, 8); unused line. Speaker assumed Zoffy, answering Ankh.
Desert Cube quoted as in source (source writes it with a middle dot).
Gijitaiyouro = GN Drive Tau (glossary), plural 'GN Drive Taus' as in story_099.
00's tentative suggestion; Wing Zero agrees in #0.431.
Zoffy reacting to the party's unheard reply that they never checked the glowing object.
Kagitaba = Key Ring (glossary item); lowercase in running dialogue.
